analysis.narrative:

Market caught between immediate headwinds (regulatory pressures, consumer weakness, policy uncertainty) and longer-term secular themes (AI/robotics adoption, institutional infrastructure buildout).

📈 **Themes:** (1) AI/robotics transformation as multi-year secular driver despite near-term noise, (2) Regulatory tightening and policy uncertainty creating tactical volatility, (3) Consumer spending deterioration and discretionary sector weakness offsetting technology strength.

Near resistance: $625-627 (41-54k OI, active). Near support: $590 (80k OI).
